question: 查询租户AdvanceService_System_VDC在区域region_guian4中的ECS实例及规格、云硬盘列表及容量
sql: SELECT d.name AS "volume_name",d.size AS "volume_size",d.status AS "volume_status",d.id AS volume_id,'volume' AS detail_kind,COALESCE(volume_vms.vm_attachments,'[]') AS vm_attachments FROM CLOUD_VOLUME AS d LEFT JOIN (SELECT volume_id,json_group_array(json_object('vm_id',mounted_vm.vm_id,'vm_name',mounted_vm.vm_name,'flavor_id',mounted_vm.flavor_id,'flavor_name',mounted_vm.flavor_name,'vcpu',mounted_vm.vcpu,'ram',mounted_vm.ram,'disk',mounted_vm.disk,'flavor_resolved',mounted_vm.flavor_resolved)) AS vm_attachments FROM (SELECT DISTINCT r.volumeId AS volume_id,v.id AS vm_id,v.name AS vm_name,v.flavorId AS flavor_id,f.name AS flavor_name,f.vcpuSize AS vcpu,f.ramSize AS ram,f.diskSize AS disk,CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS flavor_resolved FROM R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM AS r INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA AS v ON r.vmId=v.id LEFT JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR AS f ON v.flavorId=f.id) AS mounted_vm GROUP BY volume_id) AS volume_vms ON volume_vms.volume_id=d.id UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS "volume_name",NULL AS "volume_size",NULL AS "volume_status",NULL AS volume_id,'vm_without_scoped_volume' AS detail_kind,json_array(json_object('vm_id',orphan_vm.vm_id,'vm_name',orphan_vm.vm_name,'flavor_id',orphan_vm.flavor_id,'flavor_name',orphan_vm.flavor_name,'vcpu',orphan_vm.vcpu,'ram',orphan_vm.ram,'disk',orphan_vm.disk,'flavor_resolved',orphan_vm.flavor_resolved)) AS vm_attachments FROM (SELECT v.id AS vm_id,v.name AS vm_name,v.flavorId AS flavor_id,f.name AS flavor_name,f.vcpuSize AS vcpu,f.ramSize AS ram,f.diskSize AS disk,CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS flavor_resolved FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA AS v LEFT JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM AS r ON r.vmId=v.id LEFT JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME AS d ON r.volumeId=d.id LEFT JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR AS f ON v.flavorId=f.id GROUP BY v.id,v.name,v.flavorId,f.id,f.name,f.vcpuSize,f.ramSize,f.diskSize HAVING COUNT(d.id)=0) AS orphan_vm
